newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's real drops 0.09 pct in speculative trade.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's real drops 0.09 pct in speculative trade.

text.p: Brazil's real dropped 0.09 percent to close at 1.0670 per dollar in speculative trade on the commercial foreign exchange market, dealers said.
Some banks bought dollars early on Monday, anticipating strong dollar outflows, which caused the local currency to drop to 1.0688 per dollar.

But preliminary figures indicated that the dollar flows did not post a net deficit, which allowed the real to recover some ground in the late afternoon, dealers added. Preliminary figures for commercial and financial forex contracts showed a $75 million surplus on Monday.
In the interbank floating rate market, the real closed at 1.0711 per dollar, down 0.07 percent.
In the parallel market, the real rose 0.18 percent to end at 1.133 per dollar, traders said.
